overview: The Medford City Council approved a special permit for extended holiday hours at Kohl's, granted utility conduit permits, and referred a proposal regarding unfunded pension liabilities to committee.

items.title: Special Permit for Kohl's Extended Holiday Hours
items.summary: The Council approved a special permit allowing Kohl's at Meadow Glen Mall to operate 24 hours on up to eight days during the holiday shopping season, subject to delivery restrictions, police details, and annual review.

items.title: Light Tower Fiber Networks Grant of Location
items.summary: The Council approved Light Tower Fiber Networks' petition to trench Emerson Street to install fiber optic service for Massachusetts Eye and Ear at 101 Main Street.

items.title: Teleport Communications America Grant of Location
items.summary: The Council approved Teleport Communications America's petition to lay an underground conduit from Fulton Street to 59 Valley Street.

items.title: Resolution Regarding Tufts Curtis School Leadership
items.summary: The Council passed a motion requesting a report from the school superintendent regarding recent principal staffing changes and associated administrative salaries.

items.title: Resolution on Unfunded Pension Liability Funding
items.summary: The Council referred a proposal to allocate $500,000 annually from free cash to reduce unfunded pension liabilities to the Committee of the Whole for discussion with city financial officers.

items.title: Public Participation on Police and Fire Staffing and Facilities
items.summary: Resident Jeanne Martin spoke on public safety staffing and the need for a new police station, and the Council placed the petition on file.

items.title: Public Participation on Public Access Television
items.summary: Following comments from residents regarding public access media, the Council voted to request a timeline from the mayor on when public access television services will resume.

items.title: Cemetery Department Appropriations
items.summary: The Council approved the mayor's request to transfer $173,400 from grave sales to cemetery salaries and $159,759 from perpetual care funds to cemetery expenses.

items.title: Inquiry on Dog Park Fund Accounting
items.summary: The Council approved an inquiry to the mayor's office requesting a full accounting of all raised funds and donations designated for a city dog park.

items.title: Adjournment Resolution and Routine Business
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution honoring military veterans, noted legal clarifications on election rules and open meeting law, and approved prior meeting records.
